protocol.subset: 60 curated tiles; 12 scene classes; 5 tiles per class
protocol.modelRevisionCaveat: Hyper3-CLIP V1 is pinned; the original CLIP checkpoint revision was not recorded.
protocol.claimBoundary: A small curated retrieval probe, not a full remote-sensing benchmark.
protocol.sourceCaveat: The original upstream source and split of this tile selection were not recorded. The committed tiles and their hashes define this probe.
protocol.metricDefinition: P@10 is matching neighbours divided by 10, averaged over all 60 anchors. Self-matches are excluded; only four same-class neighbours are available, so same-class P@10 is capped at 40%. Group counts include same-class matches.
